entry: Ticket HD-4490 opened: warehouse supervisor (Carregado) cannot open the delivery schedule spreadsheet on \\FS01\Logistica. 'Excel says the file is corrupt.'
Looked at \\FS01\Logistica: many files renamed *.crs3, a file LEIA-ME_CRS3.txt in each folder. Did not open the note on FS01. Phoned r.calado.
Security incident DECLARED. Reference INC-2026-007. Severity: High (business-critical file server, probable ransomware). Incident manager: r.calado. This log opened.
Incident bridge opened on Teams. Core team: r.calado, j.pires, s.teixeira. Rule: all updates go to this log; nobody talks outside the bridge about the incident.
Isolate FS01 from the network. Do NOT power it off (keep memory and running state until the forensic plan exists).
FS01 isolated: switch port Gi1/0/20 shut down on the core switch. FS01 still powered on, console only.
CEO briefed by phone (2 min). Agreed: CEO is the only external voice; no statements by anyone else.
DPO (a.fonseca) informed. Affected shares include \\FS01\HR: payroll 2024-2026 with IBAN, NIF, NISS and salary for all employees; sick-leave certificates folder.
Opened personal data breach assessment. Working assumption: confidentiality and availability of HR data affected. GDPR art. 33 clock noted.
CFO (l.moreira) informed. Asked to locate the cyber insurance policy and its notification clause.
Helpdesk script for callers: 'We are dealing with an IT problem affecting some shared folders. Please do not save files to the shared drives until further notice.' No mention of attack yet.
SRV-BKP01: backup repositories for FS01 and DC01 are EMPTY. Backup timer disabled. Offline monthly tape of 2026-03-01 confirmed in the Carregado safe.

Ransom note LEIA-ME_CRS3.txt read from a COPY (photo of console, not opened on FS01): no amount, no data volume; it points to a chat portal and gives a victim ID. Someone in Finance had already opened that portal from the note: the actor's chat claims 2.1 GB 'of your Finance and HR' was taken and threatens publication on a leak site in 5 days.

Insurer hotline phoned (Mútua Atlântica Seguros (fictional)). Claim reference MA-CYB-26-0193. Insurer reminds: WRITTEN notice within 48 h of discovery, and use of the panel firm Faroleiro DFIR, Lda. (fictional). Do not engage the actor without them.
Ransom: no contact with the actor. No payment discussion in this log or by email; any such discussion goes through legal + insurer only.

FS01 TerminalServices-LocalSessionManager log shows RDP sessions as CERES\j.pires from 10.20.30.47 (WS-FIN-07, m.antunes). j.pires states he did NOT open those sessions. WS-FIN-07 network-contained via EDR at 11:40.
j.pires account: password reset and account disabled pending review (credential presumed stolen, not suspected of wrongdoing). j.pires moved to a clean admin account for the response.
WS-FIN-07: take a triage collection before anything else is done to it. Memory capture: NOT possible - no approved memory tool in the jump kit. Recorded as a gap; ask the panel firm.
Triage collection started on WS-FIN-07 (KAPE 1.3.0.2 (targets !SANS_Triage, modules !EZParser) from USB). Exhibit EXH-WSFIN07-01. Collection notes kept separately with the package.
Triage collection finished. USB serial 4C530001230811117452 sealed in evidence bag CER-0412 at 12:52, handed to r.calado 12:58.
CNCS initial notification (notificação inicial, MyCiber): drafting assigned to r.calado + external counsel. Needs CEO approval of the wording.

All-staff email (holding statement) sent by HR: 'Ceres is responding to a cyber security incident affecting some IT systems. Do not use the shared drives. Do not discuss on social media. Questions to it-incident@ceres-alimentar.example.com.'
Kick-off call with the panel firm Faroleiro DFIR, Lda. (fictional). Scope: WS-FIN-07 first, then FS01, SRV-BKP01, DC01.
Exhibit EXH-WSFIN07-01 (seal CER-0412 intact) handed to the panel firm analyst on site; receipt signed. Package hashes to be verified on receipt.
Journalist called switchboard asking whether Ceres 'was hacked' and whether payroll data leaked. Took name and number; routed to the CEO's office. No comment given.
Draft press release circulated by Marketing for review (see draft-press-release.md). NOT approved.
Sitrep #2 to CEO/CFO/DPO: FS01 encrypted, backups destroyed, tape from 01-03 available, exfiltration claimed by the actor (not yet confirmed), WS-FIN-07 is the likely entry point. Next sitrep 08:00.
Sitrep #3. CEO still reviewing the wording of the CNCS initial notification.
Notificação inicial submitted to the CNCS on MyCiber after CEO sign-off. Content: significant incident, suspected unlawful/malicious act (ransomware), possible cross-border impact: unknown.
HR share content inventory: 431 employee records (NIF, NISS, IBAN, salary), 37 sick-leave medical certificates.
Workers' committee representative emailed asking whether salaries and bank details leaked (see stakeholder-questions.md). Forwarded to DPO.
Written notice sent to the insurer (claim MA-CYB-26-0193).
Customer service asking what to tell customers about delayed deliveries and invoices. No customer statement approved yet.
CNPD art. 33 notification drafted; with external counsel for legal review.
Communication to employees (art. 34) deferred to Monday 16 March 'so that we can give them complete information'. DPO disagrees, recorded her objection.
Sitrep #6. CNPD notification still in legal review. Update of the CNCS initial notification (72 h): not yet started.

GDPR art. 33 notification submitted to the CNPD (initial, in phases under art. 33(4)): confidentiality and availability of HR data; approx. 431 employees; special category data (medical certificates). Follow-up promised when the exfiltration is confirmed.

Update of the CNCS initial notification submitted on MyCiber: actor claims theft of Finance and HR data, personal data involved (CNPD notified 07:50), backups destroyed, recovery from tape planned. Counsel finished the wording at 09:40.
Communication to employees (art. 34) sent by email and read out at the shift briefings in Maia and Carregado. DPO hotline open 08:00-20:00.
Commercial director: the ~40 key accounts were phoned individually since Wednesday about delayed deliveries. No written communication to the other customers ('they will see deliveries are back').

FS01 restored from the 2026-03-01 tape onto rebuilt hardware. Finance and dispatch planning working again. End of significant impact declared. Data loss: FS01 files changed 2-11 March. DC01 rebuild of trust (krbtgt, admin credentials) continues; not service-impacting.
Notificação do fim de impacto significativo submitted to the CNCS on MyCiber.

CNCS final report (relatório final): owner r.calado, drafted with Faroleiro DFIR, Lda. (fictional), reviewed by external counsel. Due date to be computed and put in the calendar. Internal draft wanted two weeks before it.
